name: Cat Cat
summary: Closest village walk from town: follow the path, wheel, and fields in daylight without a guide. The scenic fee at the fall and the village gate are two charges. Commercial pages put an adult gate at 150,000 đồng and a child at 70,000 đồng, with the child band either 1 m to under 1.4 m or 1 m to 1.3 m. Closing times in print run from 17:30 to 18:00.
fee: Check on arrival. Scenic fee and village gate are different.
getThere: Walk or a short ride from town. Minutes are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The water wheel, the field, and the boardwalk at Cat Cat

notice.title: Pay the scenic fee and the gate
notice.body: From 1 January 2025 the scenic fee for Thác Cát Cát is 10,000 đồng from age 16 and 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. The village gate is a second ticket. Pay each charge on its own.

body: Cat Cat is the closest of the community walks named since 2005. The village site prints both thôn Cát Cát, xã Tả Van, and San Sả Hồ commune. The 2025 xã Tả Van absorbed xã Hoàng Liên, which is where the scenic-fee decision still places the waterfall. You can walk it without a guide, on the Vietnam Tourism page. The village site lists performance slots and does not describe the path.

Performances on the village site run 9:00–9:40, 10:00–10:40, 11:00–11:40, 14:00–14:40, 15:00–15:40, 16:00–16:40, and 17:00–17:40. Set the length of the path around those slots. The houses, the path, and a pond sit under the cloud on the slope above the wheel.

Keep the gate and the scenic fee as two prices. Two commercial pages put an adult gate at 150,000 đồng. One puts a child from 1 m to under 1.4 m at 70,000 đồng. The other puts 1 m to 1.3 m at 70,000 đồng. Under 1 m is free on the first of those pages. The town decision for the gate is still the booth.

figures.caption: Houses, the path, and a pond under the cloud
figures.alt: Cat Cat houses and a pond on a terraced slope in fog

gettingThere: The village is the short trip from the church, on foot or by a ride. A published minute count is missing. The waterfall is inside the same walk, and it has its own scenic fee.

legs.heading: From the stone church
legs.body: Walk or take a short ride from the church. A published minute count is missing.

hours: Village site: 06:30–18:00, and also 07:00–18:00. A commercial page: 6:30–17:30. Performance slots run through the day at the times above.
closed: Check the gate board. The three closing times do not match.
admissionNote: Scenic fee for Thác Cát Cát from 1 January 2025: 10,000 đồng from age 16, 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. Village gate, on commercial pages: adult 150,000 đồng. Child 70,000 đồng from 1 m to under 1.4 m on one page, or from 1 m to 1.3 m on the other. Keep the scenic fee and the gate as two prices.
